description: Firmware ELF and device-tree reader outcomes on stacked random edits of real inputs. Each base (an image of amp-elf-cases.json or a tree chunk of device-tree-cases.json) has its own SplitMix64 sequence seeded with seed + its position in bases. A case draws n = 1 + r % 8; n times it draws an offset o = r % length and a width w = 1 + r % 8, then overwrites each byte from o to min(length, o + w) - 1 with r % 256, in order; it then draws r and, when r % 8 == 0, cuts the input to r' % length bytes. Each r is the next draw. An ELF outcome is [admit_elf for the reservation, read_symbols as a digest]; a tree outcome is the decode refusal, or the tree digest with the readers' changes from the unchanged tree. Refusals are indices into texts.
